answer: Concretely, the economy can chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. An identity earns only when its saffron recurs, its trellis survives audit, and a glacier from an unlinked peer confirms it.
